With U(p)=4^p-6*2^p+3^p+3 and V(p)=2*3^p-4*2^p-2, the derivative/convexity inequalities show kU+V increases from negative at 1 to positive at 2 with unique root p_m. An explicit zero-sum kernel vector at the root gives a one-dimension drop in centered Gram rank (m+1 below to m at p_m). Li–Weston exponent reduction excludes recovery of negative type beyond the endpoint. The strictly negative V on [1,2) and U increasing give strict m monotonicity and asymptotic p_infty≈1.629581635586, correction 0.342777710028/(m-2). Independently built BFS graph distance matrices and recomputed critical eigenvalue signs for m=3..10, giving m=3:1.801349035 and m=4:1.743145058, but finite checks do not establish universal theorem.
